comment: Which ServerPackCreator versions this site serves an API REFERENCE for, BESIDES the one being
released -- assemble-docs.sh folds that in from SPC_RELEASE_VERSION, so it is never listed here.
`latest` is what /api/latest points at on a build that is not a release. It MUST appear in
THE HELP IS NOT IN HERE AND HAS NO VERSIONS. /help/latest is the only help URL the site offers,
and it is whatever the build that produced the image rendered. Only the API reference is tied to
a compile, so only it is kept per version.
A VERSION LISTED HERE NEEDS A PUBLISHED RELEASE, NOT MERELY A TAG. Its API reference is fetched
from the release's `serverpackcreator-api-<version>-dokka-html.zip` asset, and a tag carries no
assets. 9.2.0 was listed here and removed on 2026-10-12: the tag 0f5ef5a8c exists on Forgejo and
the release object does not, so both forges answer 404 for that asset and the build fails hard.
MEASURED COST PER VERSION, 2026-10-19: the Dokka tree is 20 MB over 1,411 files, ~1.3 MB of what
anyone pulls because it is HTML and compresses about 15:1 in a layer. Prune this list for disk,
